<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion at m/z 211.0764 is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.0691 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1) suggests about 11 carbon atoms. The formula C₁₁H₁₄O₄ matches this mass closely (210.0892 Da, within typical experimental error) and fits the observed isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H14O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O4</final_answer>
